02 Selected project

CoachDiff↗

AI-powered League of Legends coaching

Built an AI coaching system that transforms over 60 million tokens of raw match telemetry into actionable feedback linked to replay evidence.

Multimodal Data Extraction

Combined computer vision models, HUD analysis, and game APIs to extract player positions, ability usage, health, and minion observations from replay footage.

Context Engineering & Evaluation

Designed and benchmarked eight compact telemetry formats, reducing LLM input tokens by 67% versus raw input in a repeated benchmark. Preserved the underlying observations and evaluated whether each format retained the model’s ability to identify important decisions in targeted evaluations.

Long-Sequence AI Reasoning

Built sequential, minute-by-minute analysis with a persistent factual ledger that carries relevant context across the full match. Added structured output validation, checkpoint recovery, and final synthesis to produce timestamped coaching and a complete game review.
